title: Research Analysts’ Price Target Changes for January, 18th (AAPL, ACLS, AENA, AGIO, ASML, ATO, BN, BRBY, CA, CSX)
text:
Tweet 
Research Analysts’ price target changes for Thursday, January 18th: 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) was given a $174.00 price target by analysts at Barclays PLC. The firm currently has a neutral rating on the stock. 
Axcelis Technologies (NASDAQ:ACLS) had its target price trimmed by Benchmark Co. from $36.00 to $33.00. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock. 
Aena SME (BME:AENA) was given a €195.00 ($232.14) target price by analysts at UBS Group AG. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock. 
Agios Pharmaceuticals (NASDAQ:AGIO) had its target price raised by Royal Bank of Canada to $91.00. They currently have an outperform rating on the stock. They noted that the move was a valuation call. The analysts noted that the move was a valuation call. 
ASML (NASDAQ:ASML) had its price target increased by Royal Bank of Canada to $210.00. Royal Bank of Canada currently has a sector perform rating on the stock. They noted that the move was a valuation call. The analysts noted that the move was a valuation call. 
Atmos Energy (NYSE:ATO) had its price target trimmed by Argus from $97.00 to $89.00. Argus currently has a buy rating on the stock. 
Danone (EPA:BN) was given a €75.00 ($89.29) target price by analysts at JPMorgan Chase & Co.. The firm currently has a neutral rating on the stock. 
Burberry Group (LON:BRBY) had its price target reduced by Beaufort Securities from GBX 1,980 ($26.85) to GBX 1,872 ($25.39). They currently have a buy rating on the stock. 
Carrefour (EPA:CA) was given a €16.20 ($19.29) price target by analysts at Goldman Sachs Group Inc. The firm currently has a neutral rating on the stock. 
CSX (NASDAQ:CSX) had its target price cut by Scotiabank from $63.00 to $62.50. They currently have a sector perform rating on the stock. 
CSX (NASDAQ:CSX) had its price target raised by Argus from $64.00 to $66.00. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock. 
Assicurazioni Generali (BIT:G) was given a €20.00 ($23.81) target price by analysts at JPMorgan Chase & Co.. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock. 
Scout24 (ETR:G24) was given a €37.00 ($44.05) target price by analysts at Royal Bank of Canada. The firm currently has a neutral rating on the stock. 
Goldman Sachs Group (NYSE:GS) had its price target cut by BMO Capital Markets to $221.00. The firm currently has a market perform rating on the stock. 
Hochschild Mining (LON:HOC) had its target price boosted by JPMorgan Chase & Co. from GBX 210 ($2.85) to GBX 220 ($2.98). They currently have an underweight rating on the stock. 
Hypoport (ETR:HYQ) was given a €159.00 ($189.29) target price by analysts at Warburg Research. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock. 
Magna International (NYSE:MGA) (TSE:MG) had its price target raised by BMO Capital Markets to $61.00. The firm currently has a positive rating on the stock. 
Pearson (LON:PSON) had its price target reduced by JPMorgan Chase & Co. from GBX 763 ($10.35) to GBX 760 ($10.31). The firm currently has a neutral rating on the stock. 
Charles Schwab (NYSE:SCHW) had its target price raised by Argus from $59.00 to $69.00. They currently have a buy rating on the stock. 
Zalando (FRA:ZAL) was given a €48.15 ($57.32) target price by analysts at Barclays PLC. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
